confidence_notes: Current New Orleans price indexes give a useful basis for restaurant anchors, while city drink data are thinner. Accommodation figures are holistic estimates without live listings and can vary sharply with season and events. The wine-glass estimate uses the local draft-beer price and typical restaurant markup because direct local glass pricing was unavailable.
comparable_city_reasoning: No substitute city was used for food or drink; those anchors use New Orleans city-level prices. Accommodation estimates use a broad U.S. leisure-city basis, adjusted for New Orleans' strong destination and event demand.
